entries.title: Nehemiah 9:1
segments: This month; Tishri, the seventh month.

entries.title: Nehemiah 9:3
segments: Due attention to the word of God will lead to humble confession of sin, and hearty devotion to his worship and service.

entries.title: Nehemiah 9:5
segments: Though the Lord is exalted above all human conception, yet he is pleased with the praises of his people, and glorified by all who worship him in spirit and in truth.

entries.title: Nehemiah 9:8
segments: God is faithful to his promises, and never disappoints the well-grounded hopes of those who trust in him.

entries.title: Nehemiah 9:13
segments:
Judgments; especially judicial decisions. 
 
  Statutes; what he ordained. 
 
The laws of Jehovah are all right and good; and suited to promote not only his glory, but the excellence, usefulness, and happiness of all who obey them.

entries.title: Nehemiah 9:16
segments: No mercies are so numerous, great, or long continued as to lead men, without the grace of God, to obey him; but the greater and more constant their mercies, the greater will be their ingratitude, till they ripen for ruin.

entries.title: Nehemiah 9:17
segments: Appointed a captain; resolved to do it.

entries.title: Nehemiah 9:20
segments: Thy good Spirit to instruct them; by the mouth of his servants.

The Lord, by his Spirit, often admonishes and instructs even the most rebellious; and for a long time waits to be gracious, doing them good and using all suitable means to lead them to their own destruction.

entries.title: Nehemiah 9:24
segments: Children who inherit great blessings through the instrumentality of their parents and others, not unfrequently abuse them to their own destruction.

entries.title: Nehemiah 9:27
segments: Saviors; men raised up in providence to deliver them.

entries.title: Nehemiah 9:28
segments: Life often consists much in a contest between the goodness of God and the ingratitude and rebellion of men; and though, in answer to their cries, he often delivers them from their troubles, they as often forget his mercies and trample on his commands.

entries.title: Nehemiah 9:33
segments: Sin is the cause of all trouble; and God is holy, just, and good in all the judgments he brings upon those who commit it.

entries.title: Nehemiah 9:36
segments: We are servants; in bondage to the king of Persia.

entries.title: Nehemiah 9:37
segments: Dominion over our bodies; to employ them in wars and other services, at their pleasure.

entries.title: Nehemiah 9:38
segments: We make a sure covenant; a covenant, in all sincerity, with the Lord to obey him.
